journeys.name: Register a Learner
journeys.description: Register a new learner by entering their details and submitting the registration for confirmation.

journeys.name: Amend or Withdraw a Registration
journeys.description: Amend an active or withdrawn learner registration, including withdrawal, deletion, or reactivation.

journeys.name: Reregister a Withdrawn Learner
journeys.description: Reregister a previously withdrawn learner for a new course after withdrawal is confirmed.

journeys.name: Manage Assessment Entries
journeys.description: Add, review, or remove assessment entries for a learner.

journeys.name: Manage Learner Records
journeys.description: Search for learners and view or update their records, including requesting documents and adding placements.

journeys.name: Review and Confirm T Levels
journeys.description: Review pending T Level details and confirm or raise a query as needed.

journeys.name: Request a Post-results Review or Appeal
journeys.description: Request a review or appeal of assessment results for a learner, including submitting known outcomes.

journeys.name: Change Registration Details
journeys.description: Change key fields in a learner's registration such as core, provider, name, or date of birth.

journeys.name: Download Data Files
journeys.description: View dashboards and download available data for assessments, registrations, results, or withdrawals.

journeys.name: Add or Amend Postal Address
journeys.description: Add or update the postal address for a provider or learner where required.

journeys.name: Admin: Manage Learner and Provider Data
journeys.description: As an admin, review, update, and manage learner records and provider information from the admin home.
